heading: Security Surveillance
bottomHtml:
Secure your home, office, and business with advanced NVR (Network Video Recorder), IP cameras, CCTV cameras, and security accessories from D CORE. We offer complete surveillance solutions featuring Hikvision, Dahua, Uniview, Jovision, and other trusted brands in Bangladesh.


Our NVRs support high-definition recording, remote monitoring, motion detection, and cloud backup to ensure 24/7 security. Choose from a wide range of IP cameras, dome cameras, bullet cameras, PTZ cameras, and wireless solutions designed for both indoor and outdoor use.


Along with NVRs and cameras, we provide essential security accessories such as CCTV cables, connectors, hard drives, power supply units, brackets, and mounts—ensuring a reliable and durable surveillance setup.


Whether you need enterprise-grade surveillance systems for ISPs and corporations or affordable solutions for homes and shops, D CORE delivers trusted, scalable, and cost-effective security solutions in Bangladesh.
